Welcome to Chiswick Park
An official HYROX Training Club
Visit our wellness spaces: fully-equipped gym floor with the latest cardio kit and free weights, resistance area, stretch area, Recovery Zone and an upgraded Strength and Conditioning floor. Plus, enjoy unlimited signature classes like Lift Club and Reformer Pilates included in your membership, and a 25m pool and relaxing spa.
Make laidback luxury your everyday. Ditch the fads. Find real wellness.
Join the club
